notes: Accept, with one small correction in place. The recorded hash of the published open-access article reproduces (3f3af58d…) and I re-extracted all 83 pages, mapping printed pages 249–331 from the running heads (the file's page order puts the title page last). Structure: 41 items (39 missing, 1 planned, 1 library), every missing item routed exactly once, all three source stage ids exist, both planned layer ids (ReductiveGroupsPartII RG2.3 and RG2.4) exist, the library citation mathlib:Subgroup.goursat is at Mathlib/GroupTheory/Goursat.lean:128, the Part II parent exists with the title the route reproduces, and check_paper.py passes. Coverage: of the 94 numbered environments I could extract, every definition, proposition, lemma, corollary and theorem is carried into an item, individually or inside a cited range; the only ones not carried are three remarks (4.4, 5.4, 7.6) that state no separate result, and the Stacks-project numbers the paper cites. Locators: 57 of 63 name-and-page checks land on exactly the page given, and I read the other six — the proof of Theorem 4.7's number-field case does run from p.261 to p.263 where E1 sits; Proposition 4.8 is stated on p.263 and proved on pp.264–265; Remark 2.1.3 is printed in the paper's section style, '2.1.3. Remarks.', on p.253 as the item says. The correction is item 34, whose name and locator called 7.6–7.8 all lemmas: 7.8 is printed as a corollary and 7.9 is a proposition already covered by item 32, so the range is now written out. All six findings are confirmed at their locators, including the one that matters: E6 is a real gap. Lemma 5.12 asserts Z_{M^ad}(ad_M(U′)) = Z_M(U′)/Z(M) for a bounded-index U′, while its proof starts from m whose image centralises ad_M(U) — the image of the whole group — and lands in Z_M(U[e]); since ad_M(U[e]) ⊆ ad_M(U), the centraliser in the asserted equality is the larger one, so what is proved is the inclusion Z_{M^ad}(ad_M(U)) ⊆ Z_M(U[e])/Z(M). That inclusion is what the use at the top of p.285 needs, so the recorded repair is the right one. The five misprints are each printed as quoted: the circular M(A, K, d) for M′(A, K, d) on p.263; the inverted index [U′ : U(p)] on p.259; π_p^{-1}(U_p) for π_p^{-1}(U(p)†) on p.273; H_p for H_{v′} in the hypothesis and 1/(2·c(ρ)) for c(ρ)/2 in the exponent, with Y_k for Y_l, on p.280; and 'supp' for sup_p # on p.275. Nothing was rejected or deleted and I add no finding: I read §§2, 4, 5 and 7 around the findings and the statements the routes cite, not all 83 pages line by line.
